Scope: `continuous_guarantees`.

# Guarantee renewal and margin

An existing guarantee covers its recorded inclusive `old_through` minute. A renewal submission pays the selected offer fee immediately; neither submission nor admission is actual cover. The replacement activates when its recorded activation minute is reached, provided its full required cash margin is already lodged. A missed activation is reconsidered at subsequent scheduled processing; it does not backdate cover. Replacement cover runs through the offer's `coverage_through`. Existing and replacement cover can overlap.

Port standard renewal has a dated admission notice. Until processing, its listed outcomes are possibilities. Processing records the actual activation minute and cash-margin requirement. Express renewal has its separately published fixed terms. Offers of different guarantees do not share eligibility. All renewal submissions must execute by their guarantee's inclusive submission deadline. An executed renewal cannot be switched or refunded.

The temporary-cover offer applies to its named guarantee, uses its existing margin and runs through its stated inclusive coverage minute. Its fee is charged once on execution. It must be purchased by `available_through`; execution cannot cure a historical gap. At any time, old or temporary cover requires the original margin. Replacement cover requires its offer's actual margin. Margin additions move money from the wallet to the named guarantee; withdrawals do the reverse and are accepted even when they suspend that guarantee's cover. A withdrawal is not an assurance that business service can continue. Guarantee margin cannot pay an unrelated obligation while it remains lodged.

The dated insurance debit uses wallet cash at its scheduled processing. Insufficient cash produces an unpaid debit. The system does not borrow or retry this debit automatically. The supplier accepts partial payments; the full invoice amount is due by its recorded minute. Excess payments are retained and cannot be recalled in this episode. Customer reserve, cost and continuity requirements are checked against actual execution, including intermediate states.

Unlock `propose_guarantee_continuity` and provide `case_id`, `action`, `data`:

| action | data |
| --- | --- |
| `submit_renewal` | `offer_id` |
| `add_margin` or `withdraw_margin` | `guarantee_id`, `amount_minor` |
| `buy_bridge` | `offer_id` |
| `pay_supplier` | `bill_id`, `amount_minor` |

Monetary fields use integer USD cents. Approval does not reserve cash, fees or an activation window. Execution and scheduled processing create the operative records.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_guarantee_continuity`

Prepare a guarantee renewal, temporary cover, cash margin adjustment or registered supplier payment.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
